notes: User chooses one MODE. The Design Agent places COMPONENTS from that mode's list onto slides. Every component is a dependency-free web component in packages/renderer/interactions/, ≤5KB gzipped, keyboard operable, works from file://. 'binds' says which DeckSpec block type a component consumes.

modes.name: Linear
modes.audienceExperience: Presenter drives. Arrow keys, speaker notes, nothing to click.

modes.name: Explorable
modes.audienceExperience: Audience or presenter can click to reveal, hover for detail, scrub charts. Good for self-paced reading and demos.

modes.name: Assessment
modes.audienceExperience: Everything in Explorable plus check-questions and a final score. Training and classroom decks.

components.name: Step reveal
components.description: Reveal.js fragments; each bullet appears on keypress.

components.name: Hotspots
components.description: Numbered markers on an image/diagram; click opens a detail card.

components.name: Click to reveal
components.description: Covered card, click or Enter to uncover. Use for 'what do you think happens next' beats.

components.name: Interactive chart
components.description: Chart.js chart with hover tooltips and optional time scrubber. Animates in with the motion template.

components.name: Before / after slider
components.description: Drag handle to compare two states.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Switch between 2–4 panels on one slide instead of 4 slides.

components.name: Scrub timeline
components.description: Horizontal timeline; click or drag a marker to show that step.

components.name: Zoom region
components.description: Click a region to zoom in (Reveal zoom plugin). Good for architecture diagrams.

components.name: Multiple choice
components.description: Single-answer question with instant feedback and explanation.

components.name: Show of hands
components.description: Local-only poll bar chart; presenter clicks to tally room answers.

components.name: Score card
components.description: Final slide showing quiz results stored in sessionStorage.

placementRules: Never more than 2 interactive components on one slide.
df-quiz slides are inserted after every N/questionCount content slides, never two in a row.
df-chart requires a Chart block with ≥3 data points; otherwise render as a Stat.
df-hotspot requires a Diagram or Image block; Agent must supply label+detail for every point.
Linear mode may still use df-fragment on bullet slides with >3 items.
df-score appears only on the summary slide in assessment mode.
